# GuideLink v0.1.2

The unmatched-channel policy now disables every channel without a confirmed
match, including channels needing review. When group management is enabled,
eligible provider groups left empty or containing only GuideLink-quarantined
channels are disabled too. Explicit preserve rules remain exceptions.

Provider-group cleanup uses guarded batches and checks current membership before
writing, protecting groups changed during a sync. Shared match-decision rules,
reused write plans and streamed report inserts reduce repeated work and memory
use. Report replacement remains transactional if a later batch fails.

New or missing profile layout values now default to:

- Managed playlist layout, with group/channel order.
- Channel/group auto-sort, forced numbering, number-based sorting and automatic
  number increment disabled.
- Newly imported live channels enabled, with a profile switch to override this.

Explicit saved profile choices take precedence. Existing disabled channels remain
disabled; enabling new imports does not retroactively enable them.

## Upgrade

Use the reviewed plugin update, pause GuideLink triggers while installing, and
reload Horizon and PHP-FPM workers before restoring them. Installation preserves
profiles, assignments and aliases. Defaults and the expanded disabling policy
take effect on the next applying sync, including scheduled apply runs. Preview
the proposed changes before applying where practical.

Installing GuideLink after importing a playlist is supported: discovered
assignments start disabled and unassigned. Installation alone does not modify
playlist settings or channels.

## Validation

Regression coverage includes existing-playlist installation, default and explicit
layout choices, previews, repeated syncs, preserved channel states, stale group
plans, cancellation, new imports during cleanup, and report batch rollback.

The full suite passed on both SQLite and PostgreSQL 16: 206 tests and 1,324
assertions per run. All 9 release-tool tests, the plugin validator and the
110-file Pint style check passed.
